# NeuromorphicTopologyMapping

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
The process of mapping sigma-delta converted network layers onto Loihi 2's core and routing topology to minimize communication latency. Directly impacts throughput and energy on TCC systems, as topology-aware placement avoids congestion and deadlock in spike routing.
